items.title: Henry Schein Announces Leadership Transitions
items.summary: Company to Create the Henry Schein Leadership Team to Replace its Executive Management Committee Three Executives to Become Senior Advisors Effective October 31, 2026 Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) announced today that it is creating the Henry Schein Leadership Team (HSLT) to replace its Executive Management Committee.
